BL-1077 — The launch guard ignores BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY, the very name the Qwen packs tell the operator to export, so a correctly-configured host is refused a launch and told a different variable is missing
What it solves: Reported by the coder as a priority-00 note while holding BL-1052:
"qwen-mono-router PREREQ names BAILIAN_TOKEN_PLAN_API_KEY; launcher ignores
it". Verified at spec time before minting, per the standing rule to grep the
named artifact rather than trust a symptom search: the name appears in
`start-s…
Approval context: One judgement call is yours, and it is the severity, because the number routes the ticket.
Filed as medium, not high, deliberately. Today every Qwen pack window line carries the endpoint URL, so the defect hits the guard branch that FAILS LOUD - the launch is refused with a misleading message and n…
BL-1077 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1077" (or "reject BL-1077 <reason>") to act.
